data.one_liner: Dart package for parsing phone numbers and applying various masking options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple mechanism to parse phone numbers, determine countries and phone codes using an O(1) hash table, and apply custom or automatic masks.
use_when: You need to format raw, unformatted phone numbers received from server APIs for display.
You need automatic country detection and parsing based on phone codes.
You want to apply custom phone number masks using '#' symbols.
avoid_when: You need a complex form input field formatter widget that interacts directly with TextField state (though it can be used for self phone field formatters).
You require comprehensive global phone validation that relies on external libphonenumber data.
strengths: Efficient O(1) phone code recognition using a hash table.
Supports custom target masks as well as automatic country-based masks.
weaknesses: The built-in list of countries and phone codes may not contain all combinations of alternative codes.
Limited to string parsing and masking operations rather than an out-of-the-box TextField widget formatter.
